verdict.rationale: Reviews draw on context beyond the diff: cubic auto-ingests repo context files such as README, AGENTS.md and .cursorrules, learns team conventions from feedback and historical senior reviews, and can link related repositories so reviews check shared APIs and schemas. However, no doc states that PR reviews trace call sites or related modules within the same repo; only the archived AI chat explicitly 'reads the rest of your codebase.' Missing for 10: explicit documentation that PR reviews analyze in-repo call sites and dependent modules beyond the changed hunks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of whole-repo-aware review comments.
